assessments.structure: Two Greek report blocks separated by the literal inserted bilateral note. The first supplies technique and an explicit left-knee heading; the second has an explicit right-knee heading and its own conclusion.
assessments.temporal_bilateral_ambiguity: Explicit bilateral source aggregation. No report dates establish acquisition correspondence. Shared or differing statements cannot be assigned to any image series from the text alone.
assessments.technical_followup: Determine whether selected arrays form one compatible knee protocol or grossly opposing protocols; even compatible anatomy cannot resolve assignment of these two explicitly sided reports.

A temporal relationship is plausible but undated and unproven.
